description: This Java class `FeatureDeletedStrategy` handles the `FeatureDeleted` event within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides a method to process feature-deletion events by removing the feature from a ThingBuilder.

classes.name: FeatureDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that responds to FeatureDeleted events by removing a feature from a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides a method to process a FeatureDeleted event, removing the specified feature from the ThingBuilder.
